summary: Five complete LinkedIn posts for Farrice's 48-hour credibility sprint. Each post includes: primary version, 3 hook variants, engagement protocol, lead magnet CTA, and social jacking strategy. Posts follow the Lara Acosta SLAY framework, Dual-Persona design (ICP + IFP), and Diandra Escobar's Attention Redirection principle. Post types: brandjack (Claude/OpenAI), origin story, framework post with lead magnet, hot take (anti-guru), and CMO-for-a-Day diagnostic pitch. Each post is formatted for mobile with single-line paragraphs and F-shape scan optimization.
